title: Check my microphone, my radial controls and my windows the way a hand would use them
why: On 2026-11-24 a browser that pressed, held and slid like a finger found what tests had not: my microphone errors were invisible on a phone, I stood on the send button, a tap on my Spatial hub opened the card behind it, and after choosing from my ring the next tap was swallowed. These replay those hands against a running server (server.ts on port 4173, or LELU_URL). They need Playwright and ffmpeg. They are not a physical iPhone: Safari itself still needs a person.

steps.title: On a real iPhone in Safari
steps.why: Scroll Home, Chat and an open window to the very bottom with the toolbar shown and collapsed; tap the mic, allow, speak; deny once and look for the red message; hold the + in chat, slide, release. Chromium emulating an iPhone is not Safari.
